title: cross-region-rehearsal-orchestrator: terraform + ansible + helm glue for scheduled DR rehearsals
author: Aria Morgan
description: Motivation: provide a repeatable, auditable cross-region DR rehearsal workflow for Private installs without manual runbook steps. This PR introduces a lightweight orchestrator composed of: 1) a Terraform module to provision a temporary rehearsal environment and routing controls in a secondary AZ/region; 2) an Ansible playbook collection that performs staged service failovers, KV-cache checkpointing, and health probe validations; 3) small Helm chart hooks and values that allow temporary instance pools and traffic-steering flags to be toggled by the orchestrator; 4) CI pipeline jobs that run a rehearsal in a sandboxed account and surface regressions as part of PR gating. Scope: not a full HA redesign — this glues existing infra pieces into an automated rehearsal flow and adds safety controls (dry-run, preflight checks, automatic rollback on health regressions). Changes include: terraform modules/redwood/dr-rehearsal/*, ansible/playbooks/dr_rehearsal/*, chart/redwood-private/templates/dr-switch-hook.yaml, ops/pipelines/dr-rehearsal.yaml, docs/runbooks/dr-rehearsal-playbook.md. Testing: unit tests for terraform modules, molecule tests for Ansible roles, and an end-to-end rehearsal that was run in the staging sandbox (see CI artifacts). Security/permissions: creates a least-privilege rehearsal role; audit logs and run metadata are stored in a customer-visible S3 path for postmortem. Rollback model: rehearsal orchestrator always preserves prior state snapshots and will perform automated rollback if any critical liveness/readiness checks fail. Backwards compatibility: Helm hooks default to disabled; no breaking changes expected for existing installs.
commits: feat(dr): add terraform module for rehearsal environment provisioning
feat(dr): ansible roles for staged failover and validation
chore(helm): add dr-switch-hook template and chart values
test(ci): e2e rehearsal pipeline and sandbox integration
fix(ansible): idempotency for cache checkpoint task
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Can we tighten the IAM role permissions further? The current policy allows s3:PutObject on the whole bucket — prefer prefix-limited access. — Author: Updated iam/rehearsal-policy.json to scope to replay-prefix and added a note in docs.

Priya Singh: The e2e job was flaky on the first run due to timing on KV cache snapshot restore. Suggest adding exponential backoff and health check retries. — Author: Added retry logic to ansible role and e2e script; re-ran pipeline.

Omar Haddad: Helm hooks execute during normal upgrades; ensure flag defaults prevent accidental trigger in regular upgrades. Also add explicit feature gate. — Author: Hooks default to disabled and we added 'rehearsal.enabled=false' in values.yaml with clear docstring.
CI bot: integration-tests failed on first run (timeout on control-plane bootstrap) — rerun triggered. — CI: subsequent run passed.
release_notes: Add: cross-region DR rehearsal orchestrator consisting of terraform module, ansible playbooks, Helm hooks, and CI rehearsal pipeline; Safety: preflight checks, dry-run, automatic rollback on health regressions; Docs: runbook and troubleshooting guide added.
